features: DREAM BIG & BUILD BIG - No limitations, scalable to construct as massive as desired by adding more pieces to create a creatively engineered masterpiece. Build bigger, taller, more creative and steadier structures that are stable and secure enough to hold together whatever imaginative designs you can fabricate! CREATIVITY BEYOND IMAGINATION, Create and engineer limitless varieties of castles, mansions, skyscrapers, towers, farm, shapes, animals and more!
